tracks.title: Everything Talks to Everything
tracks.about: One Asteria Account, one Asteria Intelligence, and chats that pick up in whichever app you open next. A pulse and an organ keep the whole kit in time.

tracks.title: It Compiled, Ship It
tracks.about: Two guitars disagree until the piano gets them building the same thing. Zero errors. We stopped counting the warnings.

tracks.title: Password123 (A Lament)
tracks.about: A choir mourns every password you ever reused. Then a passkey turns up and nobody has to remember anything again.

tracks.title: From Havenot to How?
tracks.about: Heavy and slow to anger. Nine plans, from Havenot to How?, all counted in Asteria tokens and none of them a limited-time offer. The choir is the receipt.

tracks.title: Ten Blue Links, Zero Ads
tracks.about: Six sources shout at once. Asteria Intelligence quietly tells four of them to sit down.

tracks.title: Clocked Out, Not Sorry
tracks.about: A pipe organ, a choir, and the exact moment the timer stops. The loudest guitars on the record are the overtime you didn't do.

tracks.title: Skip Ad (There Is No Ad)
tracks.about: Nothing flashing, nothing selling, no countdown in the corner. A piano keeps count; the strings do the work.

tracks.title: Version 27.2 (We Asked iOS)
tracks.about: We used to name it after the year. Now it's named after iOS, so at least someone else picks. The last track turns major and keeps going anyway.
